hypothesis: A frequency bank may retain useful features across tasks instead of losing them through deeper encoding.
architecture: Fixed two-qubit RY encoding+CX,measure all15 nonidentity Pauli observables,train classical readout. Hybrid quantum feature model, not end-to-end trained quantum gates.
design: 5 fresh seeds,4 tasks,128 training/256 validation/1024 test. Regularization selected only on validation. Known-zero feature coordinates removed using training variance.
measurement_cost: Up to9 local Pauli measurement settings per frequency, shared shots within settings; ideal expectations here. Additional outputs are not free.
controls: Retrain9-parameter QNN mixture and9-parameter MLP on same data in25. Multi-frequency model in26 has more features, so compare to matched-count MLP8 and generic Fourier as well.
novelty: Multiple observables/encoding frequencies are established quantum-feature ideas, not a novelty claim.
